title: Lateness Allowance on Marketplace Orders Late-Delivery Compensation
content:
**Schedule.** The lateness allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation counts the days late as the calendar days from the promised delivery date to the delivered date: a delivery at least the severe-lateness threshold of 5 days late earns the per-day late allowance of USD 1.00 once for every day late; a delivery at least the moderate-lateness threshold of 3 days late but fewer than 5 days late earns one flat late allowance of USD 3.00; any other delivery earns no lateness allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## Days late

Days late are counted in calendar days from the promised delivery date to the delivered date, both read from the order record. A delivery on the day after the promised date is 1 day late.

## Allowance by days late

| Days late | Tier | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | none | 0.00 |
| 2 | none | 0.00 |
| 3 | flat (at least 3, fewer than 5) | 3.00 |
| 4 | flat (at least 3, fewer than 5) | 3.00 |
| 5 | per day (at least 5) | 5 times 1.00, that is 5.00 |
| 8 | per day (at least 5) | 8 times 1.00, that is 8.00 |

## Points of judgement

- **At exactly 3 days late?** The flat allowance of USD 3.00 applies; 3 is at least the moderate threshold.
- **At exactly 5 days late?** The per-day rule applies from the first day: 5 times USD 1.00, that is USD 5.00, not the flat USD 3.00.
- **Hypothetical case.** An order promised for 10 October and delivered on 17 October is 7 days late and earns 7 times USD 1.00, that is USD 7.00. The dates are example inputs.
